annotations.title: Make a 3D model from an image

description: Turn one photo, render or drawing of an object into a textured 3D model. Paid — 30–60 credits by version (quality): tell the user the price and get their OK first. Returns a task_id; get_task shows the model when it is ready (a few minutes).

image_base64.description: The image as base64 or a data: URL. Give this or image_url.

image_url.description: https:// link to the image (JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB; one object on a plain background works best). Give this or image_base64.

quality.description: Wandy version: ultra = Wandy 2 (default, best for most objects; 60 credits), quality = Wandy 1.1 (best for cars; 50 credits), fast = Wandy 1 (cheapest and fastest, less detail; 30 credits)

name: generate_from_image
title: Make a 3D model from an image
